name: Luxembourg
description: Luxembourg from Count Siegfried's castle of 963 to a grand duchy, two German occupations, a founder of Europe and a centre of finance.

checkpoints.name: Counts and emperors
checkpoints.note: Siegfried built a castle in 963. His heirs became counts and dukes, and four Luxembourgs became emperors.

checkpoints.name: Fortress of Europe
checkpoints.note: Burgundy, Spain, France and Austria held the great fortress in turn.

checkpoints.name: The grand duchy
checkpoints.note: Luxembourg was made neutral in 1867, but Germany occupied it in both world wars.

checkpoints.name: Heart of Europe
checkpoints.note: Luxembourg helped found Benelux, NATO and the European Communities and became a centre of banking.
